text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan feels immense pressure in the presence of Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross—the two strongest runners of the moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seemingly unperturbed, and perhaps even eager to experience their prowess first-hand, she readies herself to brave the race.
